verdict.rationale: The Trusted Agent Protocol is the agent-to-merchant protocol Visa Intelligent Commerce uses. Its spec is publicly readable on developer.visa.com and GitHub without credentials, builds on RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures, and ships an open-licensed reference implementation that merchants can implement against Visa's public JWKS. The core Intelligent Commerce payment APIs (/acp/v1 tokens, instructions, credentials) are different: they are credential-gated and require a sandbox sign-up with terms acceptance, and production requires contacting Visa. That means only part of the commerce protocol surface is open to implement without signing anything. Missing for 10: evidence of a formally versioned protocol specification, an openly implementable (non-gated) spec for the payment/credential layer, independent corroboration.
